title: Codebase Audit: Bugs & Dead Code Cleanup
description: Deep codebase audit findings organized by severity. Covers critical bugs (use-after-close, double-close panic, race conditions), medium-priority issues (silent error swallowing, env var inconsistencies, k8s manifest gaps), and low-priority improvements (test coverage, security hardening).
epicRails: Each fix must include a test or verification step
Do not change public API contracts without discussion
Keep changes minimal and focused - one issue per PR
